headline: Gold prices drop by 3,266 taka per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) announced a price reduction for both gold and silver, effective from Tuesday morning.
details: Gold prices in the local market have decreased by a maximum of 3,266 taka per bhori. Silver prices have also seen a decline, with a maximum drop of 116 taka per bhori.
According to the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS), the new prices became effective from 10 AM on Tuesday. The reduction follows a previous increase of 2,216 taka per bhori on October 9.
The current price for 22-carat gold is 228,031 taka per bhori, while 21-carat gold is 217,767 taka and 18-carat gold is 107,032 taka. Traditional gold is priced at 152,798 taka per bhori.
Silver prices have been adjusted to 4,199 taka for 22-carat, 3,966 taka for 21-carat, 3,441 taka for 18-carat, and 2,624 taka for traditional silver per bhori.
BAJUS stated that the price drop is primarily driven by a decline in the global market. While global prices rose slightly on Tuesday, they have fallen by 145 dollars per ounce over the last month.

The decline is attributed to increased interest rates on US dollar-based bonds, which has led investors to shift away from gold. Over the last six months, global gold prices have dropped by 659 dollars.

headline: Crude bombs explode outside Madaripur judge's home
summary: Several explosions occurred near Shakuni Lake early Tuesday morning, according to local police.
details: Several crude bombs exploded outside the residence of the district and sessions judge in Madaripur town.
The incident took place early Tuesday morning near Shakuni Lake, according to Abul Kalam Azad, chief of Madaripur Sadar Model Police Station.
Police are investigating the matter to determine the motive behind the attack and identify those responsible.
